app.name: Tethercam
app.subtitle: Use your iPhone as a webcam on Windows over USB
app.localizedDescription:
Tethercam streams your iPhone camera to a Windows 11 PC over the USB cable, at up to 4K 60 fps, where it shows up as a normal webcam in Teams, Zoom, OBS, browsers and the Camera app. No account, no watermark, no Wi-Fi.

You also need the Windows app (MSI) from https://github.com/kshitizwagle/tethercam/releases and Apple Devices (Microsoft Store) on the PC.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tethercam streams your camera to your PC over the USB cable.

app.name: Ninja Links
app.subtitle: Scan and keep your Social Stream and VDO.Ninja links
app.localizedDescription: Scan a QR code from Social Stream Ninja or VDO.Ninja and the link is saved, named after what it is (dock, overlay, camera, viewer, director). Open links in-app or in Safari, copy, share, show them again as a QR code, add notes, search and reorder. Links stay on the phone.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ninja Links uses the camera to scan QR codes, and VDO.Ninja links you open can use it to send video.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VDO.Ninja links you open can send audio from the microphone.
